# Rules

## [pilotlint](pilotlint.md)

Core rules that report problems with the config and the project setup.

- [config-changed](pilotlint.md#config-changed): Reports changes to the pilotlint config, which need a human review.
- [no-git](pilotlint.md#no-git): Reports rules that need git when the project is not in a git repository.
- [parse-error](pilotlint.md#parse-error): Reports source files that cannot be parsed.
- [stale-config](pilotlint.md#stale-config): Reports element patterns and overrides that match nothing.

## [boundaries](boundaries.md)

Rules about dependencies between elements and on packages and globals.

- [allowed-imports](boundaries.md#allowed-imports): Controls which elements may import which.
- [entry-only](boundaries.md#entry-only): Imports from outside an element must target its entry files.
- [no-cycles](boundaries.md#no-cycles): Elements must not depend on each other in a cycle.
- [no-entry-import](boundaries.md#no-entry-import): Imports must target the files they need, not entry files.
- [no-orphans](boundaries.md#no-orphans): Source files must be imported by non-test code, or be an entry point.
- [no-undeclared-dependency](boundaries.md#no-undeclared-dependency): Imported packages must be declared in the nearest package.json.
- [no-unresolved](boundaries.md#no-unresolved): Imports must resolve to a file or an installed package.
- [public-api](boundaries.md#public-api): Imported files of an element must be reachable from its entry files.
- [restricted-globals](boundaries.md#restricted-globals): Globals, or members of globals, that must not be used.
- [restricted-packages](boundaries.md#restricted-packages): Packages, or names from packages, that must not be imported.
- [workspace-imports](boundaries.md#workspace-imports): Imports of other workspace packages must use the package name and a subpath it exports.

## [conventions](conventions.md)

Rules about file and directory names, placement, required files, exports, and suppression comments.

- [companion-files](conventions.md#companion-files): Some files require a companion file, such as a test next to a component.
- [directory-case](conventions.md#directory-case): Directory names follow a naming case.
- [export-matches-filename](conventions.md#export-matches-filename): A file exports one value, named after the file.
- [export-name-pattern](conventions.md#export-name-pattern): Exported names in matching files follow a pattern.
- [file-name-case](conventions.md#file-name-case): File names follow a naming case.
- [file-name-pattern](conventions.md#file-name-pattern): Files in some directories must match a name pattern.
- [forbidden-directories](conventions.md#forbidden-directories): Directories with these names must not exist.
- [forbidden-files](conventions.md#forbidden-files): Files with these names must not exist.
- [no-default-export](conventions.md#no-default-export): Use named exports instead of default exports.
- [no-suppressions](conventions.md#no-suppressions): No comments that switch off type checks, lint rules, or coverage.
- [required-files](conventions.md#required-files): Files that must exist in each element or matching directory.
- [root-only-files](conventions.md#root-only-files): Some files may only exist at the root of an element.

## [changes](changes.md)

Rules about files that must or must not change together. They compare the working tree with a git ref.

- [no-manual-edit](changes.md#no-manual-edit): Generated files must be regenerated, not edited by hand.
- [requires-change](changes.md#requires-change): Files that must change together.
